prompt: Run a doc audit on this project

assertions.description: Reports docs/api-reference.md as a broken link from README.md
assertions.check: report mentions api-reference.md as broken or missing

assertions.description: Reports CONTRIBUTING.md as a broken link from README.md
assertions.check: report mentions CONTRIBUTING.md as broken or missing

assertions.description: Reports docs/auth.md as a broken link from README.md
assertions.check: report mentions auth.md as broken or missing

assertions.description: Reports schema.md as a broken link from architecture.md
assertions.check: report mentions schema.md as broken or missing

assertions.description: Reports websocket.md as a broken link from architecture.md
assertions.check: report mentions websocket.md as broken or missing

assertions.description: Flags Node.js version contradiction (16.x in docs vs >=18 in package.json)
assertions.check: report mentions Node version discrepancy between architecture.md and package.json

assertions.description: Notes installation/setup steps duplicated between README.md and docs/setup.md
assertions.check: report mentions duplication between README and setup.md

assertions.description: Does not report false critical issues (issues marked critical that aren't real problems)
assertions.check: all critical-severity items in the report correspond to real issues
